title: WHAT EXISTS names every place a bare file name is found
intention: The rehearsal's WHAT EXISTS list names every place a bare file name is found, instead of silently resolving it to the first directory it looked in, so the cold reader is never told a file is somewhere it is not.
why: Measured 2026-11-09: rehearsal record CairnCommons/rehearsals/5183005fa134-20261109T221718.json has three gaps, every one naming cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/__main__.py missing; the file exists. The rendered WHAT EXISTS said 'present path __main__.py (at cairn/tools/bus_client/__main__.py)': what_exists's base walk breaks at the first base holding a bare name, and bus_client's directory was seen first. Outline 9.4.7.1: these records are a learner's training data, so a false gap is a wrong label.
traces_to: Outline 9.4.7.1 and 9.4.7.3 (the read is handed what exists, measured before the read); Law 3 (a measurement that names the wrong file is not one); Law 7.
how: In what_exists's 'while grew' loop, gather every base whose directory holds the name instead of breaking at the first; one hit rides as today, several ride with 'at' the first and 'also' the rest; every hit's directory becomes a base. _what_exists_lines prints '(at A; also at B)'.

clauses.claim: a bare name found under two bases rides as one present entry naming both locations, in base order, and the printed line names both
a bare name found under exactly one base rides exactly as before: 'at X' and no 'also'
the rehearsal's standing proofs stay green

decisions.text: D1: what_exists gathers every base holding an unfound relative name; one hit sets 'at' as today; several set 'at' to the first and 'also' to the rest; each hit's directory becomes a base. _what_exists_lines prints '(at A; also at B, C)'. Nothing else in rehearsal.py changes.

D2: the red-first proof builds a scratch repo with tempfile (a/x.py, b/x.py, a/only.py, and paths citing a/ and b/), calls rehearsal.what_exists and rehearsal._what_exists_lines directly for clauses 1 and 2, renders 5183005fa134 from the live commons read-only for clause 3, and runs the rehearsal's other proofs by subprocess for clause 4. PROVES keyed 1..4.

out: ticket 5183005fa134's own text (its D7 is disposed at its own rehearsal)

measured.saw: three rehearsal gaps naming cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/__main__.py missing while it exists; WHAT EXISTS printed 'present path __main__.py (at cairn/tools/bus_client/__main__.py)'
